assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

Three no-op turns in one service-hosted session. The live daemon reads the session's cumulative token and cost totals from session_v2's own columns (metrics_v2.go), which only grow, so TotalTokens is non-decreasing turn over turn. The replay golden folds the exported session_message rows instead (each assistant row's tokens), the record's 'goldens fold the rows' — both self-consistent.

## Not asserted: the fully-cached turn

The scenario's 'CacheReadTokens > 0 and fresh input = 0 for a cached turn' needs a provider that reports prompt-cache reads. mlx_lm's OpenAI-compatible server reports none, so the assistant rows carry no cache-read tokens; that half is an environment limit, as in the V1 column's 5-1 on its local model.

## Spec choices

Three working → Stop hook → ready arcs on the same session, each turn-N start at least 1000ms past turn N-1's ready (the record's floor); observations: model and non-zero tokens.
caveats: Cache-read accounting is not exercised: the local mlx_lm server reports no prompt-cache tokens.
Live totals come from session_v2's columns, the golden's from the folded rows (#2109 record, 'Export and replay').

sources.note: queryV2SessionMetrics re-folds every session_message row in seq order; cumulative tokens/cost come from the session_v2 columns
each assistant row's model.id is the step's ModelName; text items feed applyAssistantText (task-estimate scan)
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
Three no-op turns with 5s between them, then 6s
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)
